proposals.before: It happened that the war in the Middle East arose; the Japanese army held Weihai, separately seized Rongcheng, and Dengzhou was greatly shaken; Yirong requested to return home to train local militia.
proposals.after: It happened that the Sino-Japanese war arose; the Japanese army held Weihai, separately seized Rongcheng, and Dengzhou was greatly shaken; Yirong requested to return home to train local militia.
proposals.reason: 中東戰事 here means the Sino-Japanese War (China–Japan), not the Middle East; the literal gloss invents a wrong geography.

proposals.before: I beg to go to the traveling palace and state this forcefully.
proposals.after: I beg you to go to the traveling court and state this forcefully on my behalf.
proposals.reason: 乞赴行在 asks the addressee (the colleague) to go to the traveling court; the literal makes Shou Fu the traveler.

proposals.before: Shi has already died in this place; though he lectured on Western learning, he never surrendered to the enemy.'
proposals.after: Your servant has already died in this place; though he lectured on Western learning, he never surrendered to the enemy.
proposals.reason: 侍 is a humble first-person self-reference (“your servant”), not a personal name Shi.

decisions.reason: s0072 中東戰事, with 日軍據威海 and Guangxu year 20–21 context, denotes the Sino-Japanese War (China and Japan), not the Middle East; the proposed literal correctly removes the invented geography.

In the letter to a colleague (s0116 貽書同官), 乞赴行在 asks that colleague to go to the traveling court and clear Shou Fu; the original literal wrongly makes Shou Fu the traveler. The proposed agent and beneficiary match the Chinese.

decisions.after: Your servant has already died in this place; though he lectured on Western learning, he never surrendered to the enemy.'
decisions.reason: 侍 is a humble self-reference (“your servant”), not a name Shi; the proposal fixes that correctly, but the Chinese closes the quotation with 」, so the literal should keep the closing quote mark that the before field had.
